title: AI Tool Replaces Photoshop for $10
full_monologue: This $10 AI tool is changing how we edit photos. No more expensive software, no steep learning curve. It does everything from removing blemishes to background replacements. Let me show you. (cut to B-roll) Watch as it transforms a dull image into something stunning in seconds. (cut to B-roll) The results are so clean, you’d think it was done by a pro. Have you tried any AI tools for editing? Let me know in the comments.
